newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed on Wednesday in moderate trade on retail and interbank interest, dealers said.
"Government securities were narrowly mixed today amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market. The interbank rate was unchanged and volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 2.10/2.05 percent compared with Tuesday's yield of 2.07/2.02 percent and one-year at a yield of 1.70/1.65 percent against 1.63/1.58 percent.
Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$99.25/99.30 from Tuesday's close of S$99.26/99.31 and September 2001 at S$99.25/99.30 versus S$99.28/99.33.
June 2003 was unchanged from Tuesday's close of S$98.85/98.90.
The overnight interbank offered rate was unchanged from Tuesday's 2-7/8 2-3/4 percent.
